analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. Today, RSI confirmed entry into oversold territory at 34.8. ADX at 27.2 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (30.5) is higher than +DI (17.1), suggesting continued downside bias. Volume ratio at 0.73 is subdued, making directional decision difficult. The 5-day low of $83,665 is slightly higher than the 20-day low of $83,410, hinting at a potential Higher Low pattern, but the MACD histogram's improving momentum is slowing, reducing trend reversal confidence. Confirmation of the $83,410 swing support level is needed.
